title: API Rate Limiter
vague_prompt: Design a rate limiter for a public API.
hidden_guidance: 10 million requests per second at peak across the fleet
The limit is per API key and per endpoint, for example 1000 requests per minute per key
The limiter must add under 5 ms to each request at p99
A small overshoot is acceptable, but a client must never exceed 110 percent of its limit
A rejected request gets HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header and the remaining quota headers
Rule changes from the platform team must reach every node within 30 seconds
known_patterns: Token bucket or sliding window counter per key and endpoint
Central counters in Redis with an atomic increment or Lua script
Local bucket per node with periodic sync to cut the round trip
429 response with Retry-After and quota headers
Rule configuration service that pushes limits to all nodes
A stated fail-open or fail-closed choice when the counter store is down
common_misses: Clock skew between nodes that share a window
Race between the read and the increment on the counter
Hot key on one large tenant in Redis
Limiter behavior during a Redis outage
